B3_checkpoint.run_stage: G2 after freeze if within 5 CPU hours; otherwise first prerequisite of G3
B3_checkpoint.analysis: All eight new sizes; report raw cumulant-vs-mean slopes and both R_k=kappa_k-b*mean corrections a+c/L, a+c/L+d/L^2. Do not pool with G1.
B3_checkpoint.acceptance: All four corrected slopes within 3 combined SE of paper 0.668(5),0.274(18); all four fixed theoretical slope goodness-of-fit p>=0.01; precision caps and largest-size means pass.
B3_checkpoint.mean_rule: At L=512,1024,2048: abs(mean-reference)<=3 SE+0.02, reference=[ln L+13.78+ln(ln L+13.78)]/(2pi). 0.02 is declared numerical resolution tolerance, not paper uncertainty.
B3_checkpoint.failure: Same-direction >3 combined-SE slope discrepancy in both correction forms for either cumulant => FAIL_C2. Any other failed acceptance condition => INCONCLUSIVE_HOLD. No 3D confirmation starts until PASS_LIMITED_PRECISION.
B3_checkpoint.interpretation: Passing establishes independent finite-size-corrected, limited-precision baseline consistency; never paper-level precision or a proof of universality.

estimators.cumulants: unbiased k-statistics k2,k3,k4; ratios are plug-in and not asserted unbiased
estimators.bootstrap: nonparametric independent environment bootstrap; multinomial empirical triple resampling
estimators.k4_crosscheck: 40-block variance; SE_block/SE_boot outside [0.5,2] or zero/undefined SE => precision unstable, no k4 falsification claim
estimators.H3: Cov(X,Y)=(C12+C13+C23+C33), X=n1+n3,Y=n2+n3; normalize by mean n3; propagate all joint bootstrap replicates

fit.weights: inverse squared bootstrap SE, fixed at empirical estimates; bootstrap refit all sizes jointly
fit.adequacy: each fit must have chi-square goodness-of-fit p>=0.01; otherwise result inconclusive, no replacement window
fit.error: bootstrap SE of intercept; between-form disagreement retained as model dependence

H1.secondary: r3 in rect and r4 in all geometries are pre-specified but not powered to original targets; full hierarchy remains unresolved without their precision
H1.data_schedule: r2 primary uses G3 only. r3 primary in cube/neck/gap/wall2 uses fixed G3+G4 combined sample at L<=64 and G3 at L=96; no r3 verdict before G4 supplement. Secondary r4 uses the same complete combined sample where supplements exist; rect uses G3 only. No effect-dependent extension.
H1.trend_guard: For each rule require abs(y96-target)-abs(y64-target)>=-sqrt(SE96^2+SE64^2) before falsification; clear improvement toward target blocks rejection

H2.wall_dependence: Different robust outcomes between the walls restrict H2 to the specified wiring; do not pool walls

H3.status: FROZEN alongside H1/H2 after algebra + nonlinear minimization checks
H3.assumptions: S2 small-angle sigma-model saddle and microscopic wall -> Neumann. Conditional prediction, not a theorem for mirrors.
H3.data: Predeclared same fresh G3 gapped data; report in G4, no additional selection or peek-dependent samples

H4.interpretation: Asymptotic statement conditional on adequacy of both prescribed finite-size forms

decisions.endpoint: one geometry/statistic relation, combining two local rules and two fit forms
decisions.candidate: All four fits adequate; all intercept deviations same sign; each |deviation|>3 SE. For H3 subtract deterministic envelope from absolute deviation before dividing by SE.
decisions.familywise: For each pre-specified endpoint use max(two-sided normal p across both rules and both forms); Holm step-down across ALL pre-specified endpoints including secondary ratios and both H3 walls. Rejection requires Holm significance plus all guards.
decisions.consistency: No rejection alone is not confirmation. Report compatible at achieved precision only when both forms agree, fit adequacy holds, and attained precision is stated.
decisions.precision_failure: INCONCLUSIVE for the affected endpoint if prescribed precision or numerical checks fail; never enlarge error bars to force agreement
decisions.C2: B3 FAIL_C2 stops confirmation; INCONCLUSIVE_HOLD pauses before 3D sampling
decisions.C3: Robustly falsified H1 and H2 in both microscopic rules => negative-result report, no model expansion

sample_design.budget_adjustment: r4 becomes secondary; rect r3 remains secondary. cube/neck/gap/wall2 r3 at L<=64 reaches planned 0.01 SE using fixed G3+G4 totals. No full-H1 support claim if the remaining hierarchy is underpowered.

invalid_data: No silent deletions. Conserved-count failure stops run and investigation; preserve every batch. Any correction after data exposure is dated POST_HOC, original frozen protocol retained.
resource_policy: Hard stage caps prevail. Save every partial batch; if fixed N cannot be reached, report incomplete/inconclusive, do not choose samples by effects.

storage.format: int32 9 columns; one canonical copy of raw chunks, lossless compression allowed

amendment_policy: Never overwrite this registration. Before any unobserved new scope, create a dated amendment and hash; after effects are observed mark changes POST_HOC, preserving original outcomes.
